# video25 - L1 proxy reconstruction (Three.js sampled-frame baseline)

Representation level: L1 (simple geometric proxies). Protocol: CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline; not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

## Observed in the 24 reference samples
- One continuous chase-camera shot (no cuts), dusk lighting, of a yellow wide-body coupe with a rear wing seen from behind; tail lights always lit, a centre brake light lit roughly 13.5-15.6 s.
- A white coupe runs ahead the whole time: far ahead (~100 m) early, the gap closes into a right-hand hairpin (13.5-17.7 s) where the two cars are almost side by side (white on the inside/right), then the white car pulls away along the final straight.
- Track sequence: start straight with overhead "Deep Forest" gantry, grandstand + catch fence on the left, big screen on the right; braking boards; right-hand turn 1 near an oblique overpass bridge; fast section with forest on the right; gentle left bend; braking boards; right hairpin with grandstand/billboards on the outside; final straight with a left wall, an overhead GT gantry, a big screen on the right and a lit tunnel portal at the end.

## Model
- Track: a centreline integrated deterministically from keyed speed and yaw-rate profiles (precomputed table, sampled by absolute time). Asphalt ribbon 15 m wide, edge lines, red/white kerbs, green run-off, walls, translucent catch fences with posts.
- Cars: box body, cabin (dark glass), wing on struts, emissive tail lights with additive glow, plate light, diffuser, four wheels that spin with travelled distance; front wheels steer from path curvature (counter-steer during the hairpin slide). Yellow car has a slip angle through the hairpin.
- White car: same proxy in white, positioned by a keyed arclength gap and lateral offset relative to the yellow car.
- Environment: grandstand wedges, pit building, gantries, overpass, billboards, crane pole, light tower, instanced tree proxies (cones/spheres), hills and distant mountain cones, gradient sky dome with a warm glow toward the final-straight direction, fog.
- Camera: chase camera 6.5 m behind and 1.75 m above the yellow car, pitched ~4 deg down, 50 deg vertical FOV, yaw = lagged (0.45 s box-average) heading of the car, so the car stays centred and the view lags in corners.
- Timing: time = frame/fps on the reference timeline, 1439 frames; no retiming.

## Inference vs observation
Positions between samples, exact track curvature, speeds, gap profile and landmark placements are estimated from apparent image sizes/positions in the samples. Road elevation changes (uphill near turn 1) are not modelled.

## Feedback
Initial generation; no render feedback received yet.

rounds.reason: Fix missing road (ground depth issue), retime hairpin and white-car gap, landmark and appearance fixes.

Exact track curvature, speeds, landmark positions and road elevation (uphill near turn 1, not modelled) are inferred from the samples. The motion between samples is interpolated.
